issue_request: FHIR-32343 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked to define the encounter-subject-status codes, add receiving-care, relax Encounter.subjectStatus from extensible to example, and update Encounter status-management guidance and the appointment status-flow example to explain how Encounter.subjectStatus and Encounter.status interact.
initial_application: The core source application is visible in Jira-tagged commits 42a5298014 and e00352fe8a: the first relaxed Encounter.subjectStatus to an example binding, and the second updated Encounter Status Management text plus the appointment status-flow table. The terminology portion was applied through UTG proposal UP-344, which lists FHIR-32343 and the encounter-subject-status CodeSystem among its implemented change objects.
additional_context: Encounter is an active build resource in source/fhir.ini. Current core source binds Encounter.subjectStatus to ValueSet/encounter-subject-status with example strength, and current THO CodeSystem/encounter-subject-status contains arrived, triaged, receiving-care, on-leave, and departed with definitions matching the Jira resolution. Later R6 issues FHIR-54098 and FHIR-54491 touch the same narrative area but are Resolved - change required, not Applied/Published in this default run scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current FHIR core checkout plus external THO terminology already satisfy the seed request, and additional edits would be redundant or would risk folding later unresolved R6 work into this R5 Published issue audit.
